I need to cancel my Department of Labor appointment.

To prevent fraudulent cancellations, I can't cancel your appointment directly. However, I can help you get in touch with a representative who can assist you. If you have your confirmation number, I can look up your appointment details and transfer you to an agent. Would you like to provide that number?

I found your appointment details. You have an appointment scheduled for December 1, 2026, at 2:00 PM in Albany for an intake interview. To proceed with cancellation, I'll transfer you to a representative who can assist further. Would you like me to connect you now?
